title: These ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Crochet Kits Let You Create Your Own Character Plushies
summary: Create five characters with step-by-step video tutorials.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

You can now create your own KPop Demon Hunters merch with these beginner-friendly crochet kits that turn fan-favorite characters from the film into cuddly knotted toys.

The Woobles’ Extra Squeezy Crochet Kit makes it super easy to learn the craft and promises a plush character at the end. The collection includes HUNTR/X members Rumi , Zoey and Mira , plus the fan-favorite Derpy and sidekick Sussie Magpie sold separately or as part of a bundle .

Featuring all the tools novices need to get started, the crochet kits are recommended for ages 12 and up, and include custom Easy Peasy Extra Squeezy Yarn, a crochet hook, custom plastic eyes for the character you’re building, stuffing, a yarn needle and stitch markers.

Participants also get a downloadable character pattern, plus step-by-step video tutorials available for both right-handed and left-handed crocheters. The first stitch — one of the trickiest parts for beginners — is also already pre-started so you can get straight into learning the craft of crocheting. If you hit a snag, The Woobles offers unlimited email help and virtual crochet office hours.

BEGINNER'S GUIDE

'KPop Demon Hunters' Rumi Crochet Kit

$40

Buy Now at The Woobles

Rumi is roughly 4.5 inches tall.

Bring HUNTR/X leader Rumi to the crochet table with her bright yellow jacket and signature purple braid. The crochet project uses beginner and “beginner+” techniques, making it doable even for someone picking up a hook for the first time. Once you’ve crocheted your masterpiece, use the stuffing provided to insert inside the shell for a cuddly companion when you’re done.

Made a mistake? Don’t worry. Step-by-step videos provide both instruction and troubleshooting support. Also available from The Woobles is a crochet kit featuring Rumi and her sword — the iconic sain-geom weapon .

SQUEEZY YARN

'KPop Demon Hunters' Derpy Crochet Kit

1K Bought This Month

$55

$54.99

Buy Now at target

The tallest of the characters, Derpy is about 8.5 inches in height.

Derpy is the oversized, clumsy blue magical messenger who has become one of the most recognizable fan-favorite characters from KPop Demon Hunters . The kit captures his blue fur, golden eyes and distinctive look while keeping the project within beginner+ territory.

VIDEO TUTORIALS

'KPop Demon Hunters' Zoey Crochet Kit

The youngest HUNTR/X, Zoey, stands at 4 inches tall.

Zoey’s crochet kit features her teal outfit and space-bun hairstyle. Despite the character’s detailed appearance, the kit sticks to beginner and beginner+ techniques. The accompanying videos break down the process so newbies can focus on learning the stitches instead of wrestling with complicated instructions.

PRE-STARTED

'KPop Demon Hunters' Mira Crochet Kit

Crochet up to 4 inches in height for Mira.

Mira’s rebellious style gets a handmade treatment with her black top, yellow skirt and intricate pink hair. The project is built around beginner and beginner+ crochet techniques, giving newcomers a manageable way to recreate one of HUNTR/X’s most distinctive members.

PLASTIC EYES

'KPop Demon Hunters' Sussie Crochet Kit

$39.99

Sussie sits at 4.25 inches tall, but makes up for it with a full, round body.

Sussie brings a little more attitude to the collection with three pairs of golden eyes and glittering magpie-inspired plumage. The magical messenger is designed as a beginner-friendly project despite its more intricate character details — such as the beak — so you’ll feel like a crochet master when you’re finished.

For fans wanting to test their crochet skills on several characters, The Woobles KPop Demon Hunters collection includes all five characters mentioned above in a Heroes & Helpers Bundle for $210 ; all three HUNTR/X characters in the We Are Hunters Bundle for $105 ; and Derpy and Sussie in the Magical Messengers Bundle for $90 .

The Woobles kits arrive as KPop Demon Hunters has grown from a hit Netflix movie into a full-scale merchandise machine spanning dolls , Squishmallows , backpacks , bag charms , Funko figures , phone huggers , books, apparel, beauty products, food collaborations and more.

The film has also become a streaming powerhouse, surpassing 600 million views in its first year and spending 52 weeks in a row in Netflix’s Global Top 10. Its soundtrack has topped 15 billion worldwide streams, while “Golden” spent 18 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Global 200 and eight weeks at the top of the Billboard Hot 100 . The film has collected major awards as well, including two Oscars, two Golden Globes and two Critics Choice Awards, while “Golden” won a Grammy for best song written for visual media.
